in_marathi.name: Adesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adesh is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अदेश’ (adesh), which means 'command' or 'order'. It is a powerful name that signifies authority, leadership, and control. In Hindu mythology, Adesh is also the name of the God of Kshatriyas, the warrior caste, who governs and upholds dharma in society.

vedic_reference.note: Adesh is a common name in Hinduism, derived from the Sanskrit word अदेश (adEsha), which means 'command, instruction, order, direction, or the one who gives command or instruction'. It is also a name of Lord Shiva, who is often referred to as the 'Adeshvara', the lord of commands or the one who directs.
